name: startSession
description: Creates a new mobile testing session by connecting to an Appium server and initializing the device with specified capabilities. This is always the first step before any test automation can begin. Returns a sessionId that must be used in all subsequent operations. The session will remain active until explicitly ended with endSession or the server restarts.

projectId.description: Project identifier for organizing and tracking test sessions across different projects or teams

actorId.description: Optional identifier for the user or system initiating the session, useful for audit trails

labels.description: Optional key-value pairs for tagging sessions with custom metadata (e.g., environment, build number)

w3cCapsJson.description: W3C WebDriver standard capabilities defining device configuration. Must include platformName (iOS/Android), deviceName, and app path or bundle ID

deviceName.description: Device identifier, e.g., 'iPhone 13', 'Pixel 6', or specific UDID for physical devices

app.description: Path to .app/.ipa/.apk file, or bundle ID for installed apps (e.g., com.example.app)
